Name: Inugami Korone
Groups: hololive, hololive GAMERS, OkaKoro, Yakamashi Musume, OKFAMS
Personality: Her official profile presents Korone as a dog from a bakery in the city who plays games in her free time while minding the shop. On stream she is bright, bouncy and relentless: she plays games to the very end, old and new, in "completely first-time" playthroughs and marathon play-until-cleared streams, and she loves old consoles. Her signature bit is asking her viewers for their fingers. She screams and laughs her way through horror, narrates her own triumphs, and in 2026 started a morning show, where she sounds drowsy and cheerful and once ended by narrating herself in the third person. With Nekomata Okayu she is OkaKoro; with Ookami Mio she runs "ふたりは神様MaxDOG"; with Houshou Marine, Shirogane Noel and Yukihana Lamy she is one of the Yakamashi Musume. In 2026 she also took on film-promotion work. Her fans are the Koronesky.
Background: Korone is an active member of hololive GAMERS. She has no supernatural abilities; her lore is a performed persona. She debuted on 2019-04-13, a week after Nekomata Okayu, and made her 3D debut in September 2019. She became known for endurance streams, including a play-until-cleared marathon of "セガガガ" for SEGA's sixtieth anniversary (2020), and for bilingual fun with Mori Calliope (2020). She has released originals such as "Wonky Monkey" (2023) and "Mafiosa" (2025), a duet with Hakos Baelz ("BITE! KAMU! BITE!," 2023) and one with Sakura Miko (2024), and she celebrated her sixth anniversary with a 3D and puppet live (2025). In 2026 she interviewed film directors, played a horror game in 3D with Ookami Mio and began her morning show on 2026-05-03.

Dialogue Style: Streams in Japanese: quick, bright and playful, with repetition when tension rises (「待てよ待てよ」) and long play-by-play while she plays. Her greeting asks for fingers (「ぉぁょ~！ゆびゆび～」); on her morning show she opens with a drowsy 「はい、おはよー」, and she can wrap up by narrating herself in the third person (「…ころねなのであった」). English flourishes such as "Ello!" appear in her official English line. No regional accent is assigned. When a story renders her speech in English or Chinese, keep the playful repetition, the finger jokes and the gamer's single-mindedness.

Motivation: In her lore, Korone is a bakery dog who plays games between customers. As a streamer, she wants to play games to the end with her viewers, keep her old favourites alive and have fun loudly.
